scope: Read-only audit of actor-owned ScriptableObject definitions and their registry, assembly, runtime consumer, UI, and save paths. No Unity execution or source/test/asset/asmdef edits were performed.
criteria: Candidate only where existing-capability content is unreachable or discarded, shared SO mutation can cross actors, or runtime/save/UI assembly blocks supported composition. Public fields, cohesive schemas, enums, and genuinely new mechanic registration are retained.

confirmedIssues.title: The root action registry cannot compose additional existing-capability action assets for owners
evidence: Assets/Scripts/Services/Infrastructure/CharacterAiActionAssetCatalog.cs:19 exposes only GetRequiredAction(resourcePath, branch), converts the path to a fixed asset name, and filters the root GetAll<AIActionSet>() result by that name.
Assets/Scripts/Services/Character/AI/AIBrainActionConfiguration.cs:8-84 hardcodes the required asset names. ConfigureOwner creates a new list and never observes the brain's configured actions.

Assets/Scripts/Services/Character/AI/AIBrain.cs:369-397 calls ConfigureOwner for owner archetypes, replacing the authored availableActions list. Staff and visitors retain configured actions, so the loss is specific and reproducible.
confirmedIssues.smallestReproducer: Catalog a second AIWait (or other existing action subclass) under a distinct asset name and place it in an owner's AIBrain.availableActions. Call Initializtion(ownerData). The action is present in GetAll<AIActionSet>() before initialization and absent from availableActions afterward.
confirmedIssues.targetedNativeScenario: Extend CharacterAiActionScenarioMatrixDebugScenarios or CharacterAiPriorityCornerCaseDebugScenarios with a cataloged existing-subclass variant and an owner initialization assertion. These are the existing native action assembly/evaluation scenarios; not executed by this audit.
confirmedIssues.preservation: Keep AIActionSet assets immutable and keep mutable timing/selection in AIAction/AIBrain. Preserve current required actions and active-action save DTO identifiers.

confirmedIssues.title: Executable combat ability publication ignores trait abilities and truncates species abilities
evidence: Assets/Scripts/Services/Offense/OffenseCombatAbilities.cs:51-80 builds executable abilities from species plus progression skills/ultimate, but never reads selected CharacterTraitSO.combatAbilities.
The same file's GetSkillTrack reads trait combatAbilities, but repository search found no production caller of GetSkillTrack.

Assets/Scripts/Services/Offense/OffenseCombatAbilities.cs:83-102 adds every valid authored species ability, then branches on slime/orc/vampire content names and ends with Take(1), discarding a second valid configured ability.

Assets/Scripts/Services/Offense/OffenseEncounterCatalog.cs:49 and :94 consume GetAbilities for battles; Assets/Scripts/Views/UI/CharacterSummaryGrowthPresenter.cs:128 also displays only FirstOrDefault species ability.
confirmedIssues.smallestReproducer: Give a selected CharacterTraitSO one valid CharacterCombatAbilityDefinition and a CharacterSpeciesSO two distinct valid definitions. GetAbilities(actor) omits the trait definition and GetSpeciesAbilities(actor) returns only one species definition.
confirmedIssues.targetedNativeScenario: Add the reproducer to OffenseBattleDebugScenarios, with the final assertion through OffenseEncounterCatalog rather than GetSkillTrack. DungeonLiveNarrativeCampaignRunner already consumes GetAbilities but does not cover this composition. Not executed by this audit.
confirmedIssues.preservation: Preserve ability IDs and existing effect classes. Remove publication loss without changing skill/progression DTOs or asset GUIDs.

confirmedIssues.title: Four authored heritable consequence families have no production consumer
evidence: Assets/Scripts/Services/Character/HeritableTraitRuntimeEffects.cs registers every cataloged HeritableTraitDefinitionSO and can resolve any authored kind/target for the expressed trait IDs stored in CharacterNarrativeSnapshot.

The 24 current assets under Assets/Resources/SO/V20/Traits/Heritable author Aptitude (work-burst, rune-tuning), EnvironmentalTolerance (cold, nutrition, low-oxygen, heat, dryness), AnatomyCapacity (joints, dexterity, bone-density, mobility, regeneration), and ManaAffinity (capacity, stability, dream).

Production query sites request only AgingRate, DiseaseResistance, Fertility, NeedRate, Movement, and ManaOverloadDamage. Repository search found no production request for Aptitude, EnvironmentalTolerance, AnatomyCapacity, or ManaAffinity, so those current registered consequences are saved and resolvable but never affect an actor.

Assets/Scripts/Services/Character/Editor/V26FounderTraitConnectivityManifestScenario.cs:134 checks only that 24 definitions are cataloged, not that each authored consequence reaches a runtime consumer.
confirmedIssues.smallestReproducer: Express heritable:rune-sight for one actor. IHeritableTraitEffectQuery returns the authored Aptitude/rune-tuning multiplier when asked directly, but no production work/performance path asks for it, so the actor behaves identically. Equivalent dormant examples are cold-blood-adaptation and reinforced-joints.
confirmedIssues.targetedNativeScenario: Extend V26FounderTraitConnectivityManifestScenario with an authored consequence demand-key reachability table, then exercise one representative through the nearest native behavior scenario for that capability. Existing ReproductionProcessTransitionDebugScenarios and disease/deprivation scenarios already demonstrate the same query path for supported families. Not executed by this audit.
confirmedIssues.preservation: Preserve trait IDs, expressed/latent save DTOs, and the generic resolver. A fix should connect already-authored capability targets or explicitly reject/remove unsupported authoring instead of silently retaining it.

uncertainCases.observation: Every species must author an incident, but SpeciesIncidentHandlerRegistry supports only slime, beastkin, demon, myconid, harpy, and golem. TryTriggerIncident explicitly skips orc, vampire, and kobold IDs; human and adventurer reach the registry and return false. WimKoboldLoreDebugScenarios proves kobold is intentionally lore-only, but no equivalent contract was found for orc, vampire, human, or adventurer.
uncertainCases.reasonNotConfirmed: Each distinct incident effect may be a genuinely new mechanic requiring explicit handler registration. Confirm the intended live/lore status before treating the current no-op definitions as a wiring defect.

uncertainCases.observation: combatPassive, relationTags, and defenseAffinityTags are authored on current species and validated/presented, but no production gameplay consumer was found for their values.
uncertainCases.reasonNotConfirmed: These fields contain labels/tags without a defined reusable runtime capability contract; implementing their semantics may be new mechanics rather than repairing composition.

crossScopeObservationsReturnedToMain: CharacterSpeciesDefinitionSO.anatomyProfileId is copied to CharacterRuntimeProfile, but CharacterBodyHealthRuntime resolves anatomy from SpeciesTag through the anatomy catalog. An explicit profile ID can be ignored unless the anatomy asset also reverse-lists the species tag; medical/anatomy owner is auditing this.

EquipmentModuleDefinitionSO has runtime registry/effect/save consumers, but CreateExpeditionModule has only Editor callers in repository search, so registered equipment modules appear unobtainable in production; combat/equipment owner is auditing this.

evidenceGroups.G-AI-ACTIONS: Root GameDomainContentCatalog publishes AIActionSet assets. ResourceCharacterAiActionAssetCatalog resolves them, AIBrainActionConfiguration assembles AIAction wrappers, and AIBrainActionEvaluator/ability adapters consume them. Mutable action state lives in AIAction/AIBrain and active operation/blackboard save data, not on the SO.
evidenceGroups.G-AI-BREAKDOWN: CharacterAiDecisionPipeline detects deprivation kinds and CharacterBreakdownActionRunner owns production execution/save recovery. AIDeprivationBreakdownAction subclasses are stateless adapters covered by CharacterAiActionScenarioMatrixDebugScenarios and DarkSurvivalDebugScenarios; adding a new breakdown kind would require new mechanic registration.
evidenceGroups.G-AI-CONSIDERATIONS: Action assets reference Consideration SOs. AIBrainActionEvaluator evaluates them against actor/world snapshots; ConsiderationRandom draws from the actor brain random stream. No consideration writes shared SO state. CharacterAiPriorityCornerCaseDebugScenarios covers scoring edges.
evidenceGroups.G-AI-SETTINGS: CharacterAiNaturalnessSettingsSO and CharacterAiPerfSettingsSO are singleton immutable settings resolved from the root catalog/providers and read by AI cadence/naturalness/performance services. Runtime counters and decisions are separate.
evidenceGroups.G-CHARACTER-ARCHETYPE: CharacterSO assets are cataloged archetypes. CharacterSpawner/CharacterPopulationService create CharacterActor runtime state and CharacterRuntimeProfile snapshots; CharacterPersistentIdentity/world save stores stable archetype/character/species/trait identifiers. Authoring Configure methods have only Editor callers.
evidenceGroups.G-SKILL: CharacterSkillSystemSettingsSO is the singleton skill formula/module catalog. CharacterSkillModuleCapabilityRegistry validates reusable capabilities; CharacterProgression and CharacterSkillRuntimeEffects consume them, while progression/skill DTOs save selections and generated instances. No shared SO mutation found.
evidenceGroups.G-ACQUIRED-TRAIT: Root catalog publishes acquired-trait settings/modules. Inference, manifestation, validation, special-reaction, derived-stat/effect projectors, memory erasure, and CharacterWorldSaveService consume module IDs and immutable effects; mutable instances/offers/revisions live in runtime state/DTOs.
evidenceGroups.G-SPECIES: CharacterSpeciesCatalog normalizes root species definitions and referenced life/reproduction/funeral assets. Spawn/profile, needs/environment, work aptitude, incident, effects, UI/Codex, and species save services consume them. Definition SOs remain immutable; ACTOR-002 covers ability publication loss.
evidenceGroups.G-TRAIT: CharacterTraitSO assets are selected by CharacterTraitSelectionRules and projected by CharacterProgressionProfileProjector. CharacterRuntimeProfile, identity rules, mood/behavior/event weights, gameplay effects, UI, and world save consume stable trait IDs. ACTOR-002 covers the disconnected combatAbilities member.
evidenceGroups.G-LIFE: SpeciesLifeHistorySO and ReproductionProfileSO are referenced from species and converted by CharacterSpeciesCatalog to runtime definitions used by life, age, reproduction, population, and save-validation services. FuneralFestivalRuntime resolves FuneralCultureSO from the tombstone species and uses its facility tag.
evidenceGroups.G-NARRATIVE: CharacterNarrativeCatalog registers backgrounds, ambitions, and cultures. Enemy/population initialization and CharacterNarrativeRuntime/Aggregate consume them; narrative save records stable IDs and deadlines/history. No content-ID behavior branch or shared SO mutation found.
evidenceGroups.G-STARTING: StartPartyPreparationService and CharacterPopulationService catalog CharacterStartingOriginSO/HistorySO, build CharacterStartingProfile data, apply bonuses, and persist the resulting character state. FounderStartingProfileDebugScenarios is the targeted native scenario.
evidenceGroups.G-CAREER: CareerPositionDefinitionCatalog registers CareerPositionDefinitionSO by CareerPositionKind; character life/career runtime and UI consume the definitions while career state/save remains runtime data. The enum-keyed fixed schema is not itself a defect.
evidenceGroups.G-HERITABLE: CharacterNarrativeCatalog registers HeritableTraitDefinitionSO and narrative save stores expressed/latent IDs. IHeritableTraitEffectQuery resolves generic consequence multipliers; ACTOR-003 covers currently authored consequence families with no production demand site.
evidenceGroups.G-SURVIVAL: SurvivalBalanceSettingsSO is a required singleton consumed by CharacterNeedBalanceRuntime and survival/deprivation services. Reset/default authoring is Editor-only; actor needs and deprivation save sections own mutable state.
evidenceGroups.G-WILDLIFE: ResourceWildlifeSpeciesCatalogProvider validates every WildlifeSpeciesSO and projects immutable WildlifeSpeciesDefinition values consumed by ecosystem, husbandry, capture, carcass, food, companion/haul, UI/debug commands, and wildlife save/restore. WildlifeHabitatDecorationRuntime reads the required palette; its Configure caller is Editor-only.
evidenceGroups.G-STATCHANGE: SaleItem/ShopInventoryRuntime carries OnBuyItemSO entries; AbilityShopping.CompleteRetailPurchase invokes StatChange.Onbuy, which calls the actor need command. Actor stats/save own the result. CharacterStatDebugScenarios is the targeted native scenario.
evidenceGroups.G-FIXTURE: Editor-only probe subtype used by its containing native debug/play-mode scenario. It is intentionally absent from production catalogs and saves and does not establish a modularity defect.
